requirements.quote: Holiday-list notices feed the court calendar so listings on a holiday are flagged (AC, integration).
reading every date out of a holiday-list PDF needs document parsing that no parser does yet.
Only a holiday notice with a single machine-readable effective_on date is flagged here
requirements.why: Existing single-date behaviour is kept and extended with the dates parsed from the document.

deliverables.change: New pure parseHolidayList(lines): {date: ISO, name}[] reading dd/mm/yyyy, dd-Mon-yyyy etc. via normaliseDate from @causedeck/adapters (as parse-pdf-list.ts:4), skipping unreadable lines, deduped, never throws; plus parseHolidayListPdf(bytes) using layoutFromPdf and an HTML/text entry. Export from packages/intelligence/src/notices/index.ts; add parse-holiday-list.test.ts with synthetic fixtures.

Add global table notice_holiday (id, notice_id FK notice cascade, holiday_on date, name text not null non-blank check, unique(notice_id, holiday_on), index on holiday_on, timestamps), no workspace_id; add migration with the next free number under packages/db/migrations (+ regenerated meta snapshot); update packages/db/src/index.test.ts root table list, GLOBAL_TABLES where notice is listed, and packages/db/src/__tests__/notices-schema.test.ts.

Add optional dep documentFetcher (NoticeDocumentFetcher: (url, sourceId) => Promise<{bytes?: Uint8Array; text?: string; contentType: string}>). After inserting notices, for inserted rows with kind 'holiday' fetch the document, parse with parseHolidayList, insert notice_holiday rows onConflictDoNothing; any failure is logged (no content) and counted in a new report.holidayDates/holidayFailed, never failing the poll. Export type from notices/index.ts. Add tests in notices.test.ts.

listHolidayListings flags a listing when a matched holiday notice has either effective_on = list_date or a notice_holiday row with holiday_on = list_date for the forum; keep the HolidayListing shape and selectDistinct ordering. Update header comment.

loadCourtCalendar also reads notice_holiday.holiday_on (with the row's name, falling back to notice title) within [from,to] for matched holiday notices of the forum, merged with the effective_on dates; first name per date wins as today.

Extend the existing listHolidayListings and loadCourtCalendar cases (lines ~570-662): B's multi-date holiday notice flags B's listing and calendar, never A's. No new core export, so no registry change.
Update the deadlines row (line 28) and notices description: holiday dates come from notice_holiday (parsed from the holiday-list document) plus effective_on.

preserve.what: listHolidayListings and HolidayListing shape and loadCourtCalendar/CourtCalendar shape (packages/core/src/notices/holidays.ts, packages/core/src/deadlines/calendar.ts); computeDueDate and deadlines.test.ts unchanged.
pollNotices behaviour without documentFetcher (listing-only, no document body stored, notices.test.ts:132 still holds); a failing document never fails the poll or other sources.
@causedeck/fetch stays string-bodied; notice table stays global with no workspace_id (RLS unchanged); core does not import @causedeck/fetch (poll.ts:7).

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/notices src/deadlines
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/__tests__/notices-schema.test.ts src/index.test.ts

decisions.choice: Dates go in a new global table notice_holiday, not a dates array column on notice.
decisions.justification: notice is global and one row per URL (schema/notices.ts:46-81); a child table keeps names per date and an idempotent unique key, matching how notice_match is a child.

decisions.choice: Document bytes arrive through an injected optional NoticeDocumentFetcher, not through @causedeck/fetch.
decisions.justification: core must not import @causedeck/fetch (poll.ts:7) and the governed fetcher is string-only (packages/fetch/src/types.ts:43); binary PDF transport is a separate change.
already a dependency used by packages/intelligence/src/notices/parse-pdf-list.ts:4, so no new workspace dependency.
